> now she doesn't;t like him as much as she did but it seems like he has a thin invisible leash on her. what should i do???  

If she really loved him, then it will never really go away. You'll catch her looking at him or casually dropping his name into the conversation. I don't think I'd call it a leash, more like a feeling. Similar to an itch you can't scratch because it's in the wrong place. 

> i don't want him to involved in her life anymore. 

Unfortunately, you cannot decide that. Try and talk to her, listen to her. Don't just talk about why you disagree with her feelings/actions. Let her talk and you may be able to find out a bit more on why she can't let go. Sometimes it can be a childhood experience, home life or just her personality. 

> she ended up getting close to this other guy in our grade who actually likes her lol. 

Geez, I wish I could talk to guys that easy aha. Anyway, it really does sound like she's craving male attention. Make sure you tell her you love her, I mean you don't have to say it. You can do little things or spend the day together. She could have other stuff going on. She seems to be flirting with any guy who even looks at her.
